title: Decompress an XZ file
summary: Use xz to extract a .xz compressed file back to its original form. The .xz file is deleted by default unless you specify to keep it.

steps.explain: Run xz with the decompress flag and the path to the .xz file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the .xz file to decompress

alternatives.explain: Decompress and write the output to stdout (keeps the original .xz file).
